title: Freshers Orientation 2026
description: Welcome orientation for all first-year students of the 2026 batch. The program includes address by the Principal, department introductions, campus tour guidance, and an interactive Q&A session with senior students.

title: AI Hackathon 2026
description: 24-hour inter-college AI hackathon organized by the AIML department. Teams of 2–4 will build AI-powered solutions for real-world problems. Cash prizes worth Rs. 50,000. Open to all engineering students.

title: Project Expo 2026
description: Annual student project exhibition where teams from all departments showcase their mini and final-year projects. Industry judges evaluate projects. Open to college and public visitors.

title: Core Tech Symposium
description: Inter-college technical symposium organized by ECE, EEE, ICE, and IT departments. Events include paper presentations, circuit debugging, and technical quizzes.

title: Circuit Workshop
description: Hands-on Arduino and embedded systems workshop for second and third-year ECE students. Participants will build a working IoT project in one day.

title: Mechanical Symposium — MechFest 2026
description: Annual mechanical engineering symposium conducted in the ME Workshop. Events include paper presentations, technical quizzes, and model fabrication contests.

title: Annual Tech Fest — Techno 2026
description: College-wide inter-departmental technical festival with events in coding, electronics, robotics, design, and innovation. 3-day event with external college participation.

title: Placement Training — Resume Writing
description: Workshop on professional resume writing and LinkedIn optimization for final-year students. Conducted by the Placement Cell.

title: General Conference 2026
description: College-wide general conference with keynote speakers from industry and academia discussing emerging technologies and career opportunities.

title: Data Science Bootcamp
description: Intensive 3-day bootcamp on data science using Python. Topics include pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and real dataset case studies. Organized by Data Mavericks club.

title: Cybersecurity Awareness Workshop
description: Half-day workshop on digital safety, phishing prevention, password hygiene, and ethical hacking basics. Open to all students.

title: Sports Meet 2026
description: Annual inter-department sports meet. Events include cricket, football, volleyball, basketball, athletics, chess, and carrom. Department-wise participation required.

title: Library Week 2026
description: Week-long book exhibition, reading challenges, and library awareness activities organized by the Library Office.

title: Entrepreneurship Conclave
description: Panel discussion and pitch session featuring alumni entrepreneurs and startup mentors. Organized by Innovators Guild.

title: Placement Drive — Infosys
description: On-campus placement drive by Infosys for final-year students from CSE, IT, AIML, AIDS, and CSBS departments.
